label: Capacitor current from voltage slew
subgoals: Write the capacitor current as capacitance times the voltage slope
Compute the slope as the voltage change over the ramp time
Express picofarads times volts per nanosecond in milliamperes

label: Inductor voltage from current slew
subgoals: Write the inductor voltage as inductance times the current slope
Compute the slope as the current change over its duration
Express nanohenries times milliamperes per nanosecond in millivolts

label: Stored energy
subgoals: Multiply half the capacitance by the voltage squared
Multiply half the inductance by the current squared
Track the units to picojoules or femtojoules
